Subject: Post-discovery: Next steps & 30m demo — 3 time options

Hi Ali/Priya —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful context on the workflows you want to improve (indexing latency, private model routing, and embedding refresh cadence). Per our call, the natural next step is a 30-minute product walkthrough focused on:

- How Redwood can match your latency SLOs across mixed GPU fleets
- Prefix/KV caching patterns for your ingestion flow
- Security controls (VPC private deployment + KMS options) relevant to PHI-like data

Can you please pick one of the three 30-minute windows below (all PDT):

A) Tuesday Aug 18 — 10:00–10:30 AM
B) Wednesday Aug 19 — 2:00–2:30 PM
C) Thursday Aug 20 — 4:30–5:00 PM

Marcus (SE) will join to cover the technical knobs and demonstrate a short replay of a config for streaming inference. Ben (AM) will join to cover next-steps for procurement and pricing guardrails.

I attached a short recap of our discovery and a proposed demo agenda to make it easier to pick. If none of these work, tell us 2 windows that do and we’ll flex.

Next steps we anticipate: confirm time, share a 1-page agenda and attendee list, and prepare a quick tenant example (no customer data) for the demo.

Thanks —

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0182

Laura —

Appreciate the recap and the clear agenda. Priya and I are aligned that we want the demo to include a quick section on security (VPC + KMS) and a short walk-through of how you handle KV cache invalidation for frequent embedding updates.

Of the options you proposed, B (Wed 2:00–2:30 PM) looks best for the core team. C could work for some of our engineers but is late in the day. Is there any flexibility to move C earlier (say 3:30 PM)? If not, we’ll take B.

Also can you confirm who will present the short tenant example and whether it requires any pre-demo access from our side?

Thanks —
Ali
